name: Runey

failures: rubric #10 hairline card borders + light-gray sparkline strokes read <3:1
native #6 accent is the app's own green, not the system accent
native #10 no traffic lights / frameless marketing render

tokens.notes: content area, light; perspective-tilted composite so all values estimated
icon-only web nav rail, not a macOS source list

tokens.value: #0A0A0A drenched black + green liquid-glass fluid render
tokens.notes: cashflow Von-Restorff card carrying primary CTAs
app's own brand accent, NOT system accent

tokens.value: rounded-geometric sans (double-story a/g, rounded terminals), brand webfont, NOT SF Pro

patterns.key_values: 4-up KPI cards: label + trailing %-badge + ~36px value + sub-caption + faint sparkline; white cards, ~18-20px radius, soft shadow + hairline
web ICON RAIL (not macOS source list): ~56-64px black, ~12 monochrome line glyphs, icon-only no labels, selected = rounded-square fill; recognition-over-recall risk
Activities feed: avatar + bold-lede line ('Someone viewed invoice RNY-...') + tertiary timestamp, newest-first
header trailing cluster: search glyph + bell w/ count badge + avatar + capsule 'Last 30 Days' period picker
coin-stack area chart: each x-point is a 3-D coin token stack topped with client brand logo + '+N' counter on a green gradient area fill; green=paid, orange=expense

signature_moves: Coin-stack revenue chart — abstract balance line rendered as tactile stacked-coin columns topped with client/tool brand logos and +N counters; a gamified coin-pusher money metaphor that is the app's whole personality

Single drenched-black liquid-glass hero card among all-white cards — the lone dark Von-Restorff element carries the primary CTAs and echoes the marketing backdrop's black+green fluid motif into the product
Rounded-geometric brand sans throughout — warmth-by-typeface that makes an invoicing/money tool feel approachable, deliberately anti the cold Inter/grotesque fintech default
defects: Contrast Dilution (mild) — hairline card borders and light-gray sparkline strokes <3:1; small pale-tint badge text borderline <4.5:1
Recognition-over-recall risk — icon-only nav rail, 11 unlabeled destinations, weak information scent
Non-native as a Mac app — zero macOS chrome/conventions; web dashboard in a frameless render (lineage finding, not a flaw of the web product)

aesthetic.direction: rounded-sans playful fintech — Playful/toy type-and-shape (rounded geometric sans, pill everything, saturated lime-green) remixed onto a Neo-grotesque-product dashboard skeleton (calm white cards, one electric accent, one drenched dark hero)

psychology: Von Restorff effect — the single black hero card among white cards pulls the eye to the cashflow + primary CTA region
Aesthetic-Usability effect — polished, friendly rounded surface raises the trust prior for a money/invoicing tool at first contact
Goal-Gradient / Zeigarnik — momentum %-badges ('+24%') and a newest-first activity feed create earned-progress and open-loop pull
Label/value hierarchy (Refactoring-UI) honored — KPI values outrank their gray labels in size and weight; hierarchy via de-emphasis
Recognition-over-recall VIOLATED — icon-only nav rail forces memorization; weak information scent (Pirolli & Card)
notes: Only input was the cover marketing composite (no standalone shots); app window is Y-axis perspective-tilted so ALL measurements are estimated with wide ranges. Cover backdrop (black + green liquid-glass waves + white rounded headline) is brand evidence, distinct from the light dashboard window which is design evidence. IMPORTANT decode anomaly: a 2400x1260 'Revone' image (blue theme, real macOS traffic lights, 'All Your Revenue in One Place for macOS') appeared from one bad webp conversion; it is a DIFFERENT product and was discarded — the reference decoders (dwebp/magick/PIL-seek/fresh-sips) all agree cover.webp is the 1920x1008 green Runey dashboard. Lineage web-electron: contrast evidence only, must NOT feed macOS canon or native clusters. The icon (R monogram, black rounded-square, chrome-beveled 'R') matches the dashboard logo and confirms identity but was not icon-digested (Workflow A task only).
